description: Starts a short explainer clip that SHOWS what the WooCommerce offer in the live room looks like: the offer card with product, price, voucher and buy button, in motion. It is a clip for the host, sales and marketing, NOT a video for the participants, and it touches nothing in the room. Side effect: it costs money on the host's video provider account, per produced second, the provider stores the clip and the description, and video is not covered by zero data retention; say both before the first clip. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` and a clear yes (`confirm` true). `prompt` describes the scene and `seconds` is 4 to 15, default 6. `submitted` true means the task really runs; check it with wi_get_explainer_video and never claim a finished clip before that answer says succeeded and carries a link.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host agreed that the clip costs money and is stored by the provider.

prompt.description: What the clip should show. Leave it out for the prefilled WooCommerce offer scene.

seconds.description: Length in whole seconds, 4 to 15. Default 6. The provider charges per produced second.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_create_explainer_video
title: Make a short explainer clip of the webinar
